description: Model routing config for the Sentinel worker's summaries. Ships no container.
_doc: Config only: it writes /etc/vibe-sentinel/ai/router-client.json and starts nothing. Local vibellm by default; cloud Anthropic is opt-in, metadata-only, and every call is written to the disclosure log. When the Vibe Appliance's vibe-ai-router is on the same host, setup.sh says so - two routers for one firm means two sets of provider keys, two cost ledgers and two disclosure logs.

preUninstallExport.description: pg_dump of every database, a tarball per volume, host state, config and an EXPORT-MANIFEST.json. Runs BEFORE anything is removed; skipping takes a typed confirmation.
